div.div:
fabric_addr_map (axi_pkg::xbar_rule_64_t):
[0] RAM: RamBaseAddr .. +RamSize (0x80000000)
[1] UART: UartBaseAddr .. +UartSize (0x10000000)
[2] DEBUG: DebugBaseAddr .. +DebugSize (e.g. 0x00000000 in ROM-select)
[3] CLINT: ClintBaseAddr .. +ClintSize (0x02000000)
[4] DMA: DmaBaseAddr .. +DmaSize (0x01000000)
decode miss -> built-in error slave (DECERR)

div.div:
AXI protocol checkers (sim only):
- one soc_axi_protocol_checker on each core_axi_req[i] (xbar slave ports)
- one on each target_axi_req[i] (xbar master ports)
Single-beat invariants: len == 0, w.last == 1, payload stable while valid && !ready.
CVA6 mode (CoreType = CORE_CVA6): replaces RV32 instr/data OBI bridges with corejack_cva6_axi_adapter; AXI[1] is tied to '0 (no second initiator).
